outcome: The two ingested objects are now reduced to a joinable grain: actual_by_gl_month rolls DUB actuals up to (gl_code, month) summing across cost centres (with a constant plant='DUB' column for downstream scoping and the active-batch filter inherited from actual_by_key_month), and budget_by_gl_month rolls the active budget batch up to (gl_code, month) preserving a deterministic Budget-Components label set. Each reflects only its active batch (a retained prior batch never changes it; a budget reload leaves actuals untouched), proven against the warehouse DB. This is the fan-out-safe foundation for the task-2 cross-object Budget-Actual join.
